title: docs(adr-0056): AdminScopeSchema target shape lists only the live keys
body:
Fixes #12660
Clause-②: no

ADR-0056's `AdminScopeSchema` bullet listed `manageBindings` and `authorEnvironmentSets` as part of the "exact target shape" for the `admin_scope` editor. objectstack-ai/objectstack#23488 retired both keys. This amends that bullet: it now lists the four live keys and states in one clause that the two keys were retired by that change and are refused by the spec. A second place in the same file, the P3 implementation-log entry, also named the -bindings / author-env-sets toggles; it now names only the controls the editor still carries (business-unit + subtree, manage-assignments toggle, `assignablePermissionSets[]`) and notes the other two were removed with objectui#12659 when the spec retired those keys (verified: #12659 removed both controls from `PermissionAdvancedFacets`).

## Measurement

Installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.3, `AdminScopeSchema.shape` keys: `businessUnit`, `includeSubtree`, `manageAssignments`, `manageBindings`, `authorEnvironmentSets`, `assignablePermissionSets`. The last-but-one pair are tombstones: `safeParse({ businessUnit: 'x', manageBindings: true })` and the `authorEnvironmentSets` equivalent both fail with an `invalid_type` (expected `never`) issue saying the key "was removed in @objectstack/spec 18"; the bare `{ businessUnit: 'x' }` parses. The live set is exactly `businessUnit`, `includeSubtree`, `manageAssignments`, `assignablePermissionSets`, with no other drift versus the bullet.

## Gates

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 ("no changeset is owed"; docs-only diff, no changeset added).
- `pnpm check:doc-example-readers`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0 (0 new citations); both re-run on head 2e2c31bfbf, check-changeset-presence exit 0.
- Control-character self-scan of the touched file: clean. `scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` does not exist in this repo (MODULE_NOT_FOUND, not a gate verdict).
- No package tests owed (docs-only).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
ADR-0056 里描述「委托管理范围(admin_scope)编辑器目标形状」的那一条,去掉了已被规格退役的两个字段(manageBindings、authorEnvironmentSets),只保留现行的四个字段,并加一句话说明这两个字段已由 objectstack#23488 退役。同一文件里的第二处(P3 实施记录里「manage-assignments / -bindings / author-env-sets 开关」的括号)也已改为只写编辑器现在实际提供的控件,并注明另两个开关随 objectui#12659 移除。

### 为什么改
规格已经拒收这两个字段,但 ADR 仍把它们当作「精确的目标形状」。照着 ADR 做编辑器的人(或 AI)会去实现一个规格必然拒绝的字段。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
只改 ADR-0056 一个文件里的两处文字,不影响运行时与发布包,无需 changeset。回滚即还原这两处。
